1: // game.js – simple Neon Grid Escape implementation
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Player
12:   const player = {
13:     size: 20,
14:     x: width / 2 - 10,
15:     y: height - 40,
16:     speed: 4,
17:     color: '#0ff',
18:   };
19: 
20:   // Game state
21:   let spikes = [];
22:   let lasers = [];
23:   let gridOffset = 0;
24:   let frame = 0;
25:   let score = 0;
26:   let running = true;
27: 
28:   // Input handling
29:   const keys = {};
30:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
31:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
32: 
33:   function spawnSpike() {
34:     const size = 20;
35:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
36:     spikes.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed: 2, color: '#f0f' });
37:   }
38: 
39:   function spawnLaser() {
40:     const thickness = 8;
41:     const y = -thickness;
42:     const speed = 1.5;
43:     const direction = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1; // left to right or reverse
44:     const length = Math.random() * (width / 2) + width / 4;
45:     const startX = direction === 1 ? -length : width;
46:     lasers.push({ x: startX, y, length, thickness, speed, direction, color: '#f00' });
47:   }
48: 
49:   function update() {
50:     if (!running) return;
51:     // Move player
52:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
53:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
54:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
55:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
56:     // Keep within bounds
57:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - player.size, player.x));
58:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - player.size, player.y));
59: 
60:     // Update spikes
61:     spikes.forEach(s => s.y += s.speed);
62:     spikes = spikes.filter(s => s.y < height);
63: 
64:     // Update lasers
65:     lasers.forEach(l => {
66:       l.y += l.speed;
67:       l.x += l.speed * l.direction;
68:     });
69:     lasers = lasers.filter(l => l.y < height && (l.direction === 1 ? l.x < width : l.x > -l.length));
70: 
71:     // Spawn obstacles
72:     if (frame % 80 === 0) spawnSpike();
73:     if (frame % 200 === 0) spawnLaser();
74: 
75:     // Collision detection
76:     const hit = spikes.some(s =>
77:       player.x < s.x + s.size && player.x + player.size > s.x &&
78:       player.y < s.y + s.size && player.y + player.size > s.y);
79:     const laserHit = lasers.some(l => {
80:       // laser is a moving rectangle
81:       const lx = l.x;
82:       const ly = l.y;
83:       const lw = l.length;
84:       const lh = l.thickness;
85:       return player.x < lx + lw && player.x + player.size > lx &&
86:              player.y < ly + lh && player.y + player.size > ly;
87:     });
88:     if (hit || laserHit) {
89:       running = false;
90:     }
91: 
92:     // Grid scrolling effect
93:     gridOffset = (gridOffset + 2) % 40;
94:     frame++;
95:     score = Math.floor(frame / 60);
96:   }
97: 
98:   function drawGrid() {
99:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
100:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
101:     for (let x = gridOffset; x < width; x += 40) {
102:       ctx.beginPath();
103:       ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
104:       ctx.lineTo(x, height);
105:       ctx.stroke();
106:     }
107:     for (let y = gridOffset; y < height; y += 40) {
108:       ctx.beginPath();
109:       ctx.moveTo(0, y);
110:       ctx.lineTo(width, y);
111:       ctx.stroke();
112:     }
113:   }
114: 
115:   function render() {
116:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
117:     // Background
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
119:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
120:     // Grid
121:     drawGrid();
122:     // Player
123:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
124:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.size, player.size);
125:     // Spikes (draw as triangles)
126:     spikes.forEach(s => {
127:       ctx.fillStyle = s.color;
128:       ctx.beginPath();
129:       ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + s.size);
130:       ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size / 2, s.y);
131:       ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.size, s.y + s.size);
132:       ctx.closePath();
133:       ctx.fill();
134:     });
135:     // Lasers (rectangles)
136:     lasers.forEach(l => {
137:       ctx.fillStyle = l.color;
138:       ctx.fillRect(l.x, l.y, l.length, l.thickness);
139:     });
140:     // Score
141:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
142:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
143:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
144:     if (!running) {
145:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
146:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
147:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
148:       ctx.font = '48px monospace';
149:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
150:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
151:     }
152:   }
153: 
154:   function loop() {
155:     if (running) {
156:       update();
157:     }
158:     render();
159:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
160:   }
161: 
162:   // Start the game
163:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
164: })();

(End of file - total 164 lines)
</content>
